purpose: fixed-depth search cost; not an Elo or playing-strength measurement
table_policy: fresh ucinewgame per sample; cold search table; no persistent-game reuse
timing_policy: wall includes UCI play transaction and game reset; process startup excluded
order_policy: seeded shuffle of positions per repetition; engine order alternates for each position

harness_checkout.scope: harness checkout, not proof of either binary's build source

document.provenance: The first eight lines duplicate Regicide's developer-composed comparison openings. Two developer-composed positions exercise recaptures and a pawn endgame. No downloaded opening or puzzle data.
document.selection_policy: Declared before observing benchmark or match results. Run the entire ordered set; repetition order is deterministically shuffled. These positions measure search cost, not playing strength.
